goal: Make Linux release binaries portable to non-glibc distributions like Alpine and systems with older glibc
Provide self-contained static executables without requiring dynamic loader shims
agreement: Strong support with successful testing across diverse distributions and architectures
Verified running without shims on Alpine, NixOS, and older Fedora (jsarenik, 0xB10C, hebasto)
Favors glibc static-pie over musl as a more auditable and palatable approach (theuni)
Resolved objections on NSS resolution, startup crashes, and locale path leaks (luke-jr, sedited)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it fixes release binary compatibility across diverse Linux environments
Enables running on non-glibc distributions and older Linux systems without external shims
